Definition
[Hyperbolic cusp] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0207 1. ch31:31.34\group Hyperbolic cusps

For a flat $(n-1)$-manifold $(\mathcal V,g_{\rm flat})$, a hyperbolic cusp is \[ ([0,\infty )\times \mathcal V,\ g_{\rm cusp}=dr^2+e^{-2r}g_{\rm flat}). \]
